title: Node restarts SCHC retry timer before repair batch finishes
description: Correctness review of pro2 implementation found Node._process_received signals outbound session activity before transmitting a negative-ACK repair batch. The driver can therefore begin the next 10-second wait while potentially slow LoRa fragment/ACK-REQ transmissions are still in progress, shortening the required post-request retransmission interval. Signal/reset the timer only after the complete repair output batch is radio-accepted; preserve terminal ACK handling and radio-failure abort behavior.
notes: Fixed with explicit paused/deadline timer state: ACK stops the old timer immediately, and a fresh full interval begins only after repair batch radio acceptance. Regression blocks repair TX beyond timer and proves no premature timeout.
